description: This file defines extension methods for the System.Net.Sockets.Socket class, providing functionalities to enable TCP Loopback Fast Path and KeepAlive options to optimize socket performance.

classes.name: SocketExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the Socket class to configure performance-related options.

methods.name: EnableFastPath
methods.description: Enables TCP Loopback Fast Path on the specified socket, if running on Windows 8/Server 2012 or later.

methods.name: EnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP KeepAlive on the specified socket with configurable timing parameters.
